flax.definition:
n. fiber of the flax plant that is made into thread and woven into linen fabric
n. plant of the genus Linum that is cultivated for its seeds and for the fibers of its stem
flax.translation:
n. 亚麻, 麻布, 亚麻织品
[医] 亚麻

flax(-seed) oil.translation: [化] 亚麻油; 亚麻子油

flaxedil.definition: n neuromuscular blocking agent (trade name Flaxedil) used as a muscle relaxant in the administration of anesthesia

flaxen.definition: s. of hair color; pale yellowish to yellowish brown
